correctness.rationale: Exact formula D_jk=1_{k<=j}(H_j-H_{k-1}-log(j/k))/j splits as (R_j-S_k)/j with |R_j|=O(1/j), |S_k|=O(1/k). Dyadic diagonal block compression B_m is two weighted triangular-ones matrices; s_r(L_N)<=CN/r via rank-r interval decomposition, hence s_r(B_m)<=C/(2^m r). Summing min(2^m,C/(2^m t)) gives N_B(t)=O(t^-1/2). Far rectangles m>ell separate into two rank-one matrices whose singular-value p powers are summable over all blocks for each p>0, so F is in every Schatten quasi-ideal and D=B+F has s_n(D)=O(n^-2). D is trace class; triangular diagonal j^-2 gives Tr(D^k)=ζ(2k) and sine Fredholm determinant, hence simple nonzero eigenvalues j^-2. Weyl eigenvalue/singular p-majorization excludes p<=1/2. Independent rational/finite matrix calculations corroborated decomposition and sample spectrum, but infinite counting argument is the proof.
